title: npm run repin can pin a local build of a commit that is gone
foundBy: session agent, after rewriting unpushed history left store entries for commits no branch holds
details: `scripts/repin-npm.mjs` takes the newest local build in the store whatever its commit. After a rebase or a squash, the store still holds builds of the commits that were replaced, and they carry the newest times. So `npm run repin` can pin a version whose commit no branch of the sibling's checkout holds any more.
